edits.new: After the pack ice crushed their ship, Shackleton's party struggled across the floes, ferrying loads in relays; after four days of hard effort he decided to camp on a thick floe and wait. He wrote down his reasons: the snow was too soft to get far, and leads might open close by.

edits.new: A second reading, and it is the author's, concerns the standard behind the choices. Gold coins were of no use on the ice; the photographs and a page with the Queen's handwriting could not buy anything either, yet those were the things kept. He gives no reason in these passages. Perhaps the limit screened only for weight; perhaps it was personal preference. Both go beyond what he wrote.

edits.new: Everything in this piece comes from Shackleton's own narrative, read here through the OCR text of the 1920 printing: the account of a participant who led the party, parts of which read like a contemporary diary. No other member's diary has been brought in for comparison. What the rest of the camp thought, and whether anyone questioned the decision, is not in the evidence, and this piece does not put feelings in their mouths.
场景一：一个创业团队的融资没谈成，原计划已经不成立。负责人第一次全员会上最有用的，也许就是像那句“任务是让全体队员抵达陆地”一样，用一句话说清新的目标：现在要做到什么，怎么算做到。

edits.new: Scenario one: a start-up's fundraising has fallen through and the original plan no longer stands. At the first all-hands meeting, the most useful thing the founder can do may be what that line did, "The task is to reach land with all the members of the Expedition": state the new goal in one sentence, what has to be achieved now and how you will know.
全部来自沙克尔顿本人的叙述（本篇用1920年印本的 OCR 文本），是当事人、领导者的记述，没有其他队员的日记作对照；OCR 有讹字，引用只取清晰片段；文中数字均出自该记述，未经独立核对；本篇不涉及此后的获救过程。

Everything here comes from Shackleton's own narrative (this piece uses the OCR text of the 1920 printing): the account of the participant who led the party, with no other member's diary for comparison. The OCR carries errors, and quotations are drawn only from clean stretches. Every figure in the piece comes from that account and has not been independently verified. The rescue that followed is not covered here.
